{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Otheruses|Corusca}}
{{Quote|They can slice through transparisteel like a laser goes through Sullustan jam.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], on the strength of Corusca gems|<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>}}
[[File:RareCoruscaGem.png|150px|thumb|A rare Corusca gem]]
'''Corusca gems''', also called '''Corusca jewels''' or '''stones''' were extremely rare and valuable [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. They were produced in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a number of [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]], which included [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], by a combination of the extreme pressures present&mdash;pressures great enough to crush elements together&mdash;and the scraping of the liquefied air of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] against its metallic core. The sizes of Corusca gems increased with proximity to the core of Yavin. They could be found only in very select locations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and their vibrancy resulted in them becoming the namesake of the galactic capital: [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Corusca Gem casino]] was also named after these gems.

Corusca gems were mostly valued for their beauty. The way that light reflected inside a Corusca gem would make it seem as if it had a furnace within it. As a result, there were many [[Corusca fishermen|Corusca gem fisherman]], such as [[Bash Fateau]], who made a living out of collecting the gems.

Corusca gems were some of the hardest objects known to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and had industrial as well as decorative applications. Large Corusca gems were mounted on drills and used for precision drilling when explosives could not be used.

Despite their well-known strength, Corusca gems had [[Shatterpoint/Legends|shatterpoints]], minuscule points where multiple edges and facets would come together, forming an extremely weak spot. If delivered at exactly the right point, and exactly the right way, the slightest tap could cause the entire gem to crumble.

[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] once tempted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with a bag of Corusca gems as an example of how he could have anything he wanted, if only he were to ask for it. Skywalker, however, was not interested, as the only thing he truly wanted at the time was to prevent the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], which he had seen prophesied in a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]].<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] used a Corusca gem worth the price of an entire Coruscant city block, which he acquired at [[GemDiver Station]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] mining station, to power [[Jacen Solo's lightsaber|his]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="YJK:L">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref> [[Ganner Rhysode]] was another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known to use a Corusca gem in his lightsaber, until it was destroyed by Jacen Solo when he feigned alliance with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
